dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "The light is fading... My crystal lamp should last for another 4 hours..."

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "...There's not much food left. I should be able to find the water filter from memory, but we must find a new source of light..."

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "Huh, those lights are floating... or are they walking? Am I starting to see things due to a lack of oxygen?"
